description.value: Alberni District Liquor is a liquor retail store serving the Port Alberni area on Vancouver Island, a gateway community to the scenic Alberni Valley and Pacific Rim routes. Cyclists travelling the west coast corridor can stop here to pick up beer, wine, or spirits. The store appears to be a locally operated shop rather than a major chain.
